name: Event store with snapshots and time-travel state (multi-file)
instruction: Implement BOTH files (CommonJS, no dependencies). store.js exports createStore(reducer, snapshotEvery). append(event) applies the event via reducer(state, event) (initial state comes from reducer(undefined, {type:'@init'})), increments the version (first append => version 1), and every snapshotEvery-th version records an internal snapshot of the state at that version (deep-copied — later mutations must not corrupt it). version() returns the current version. stateAt(v) returns the state as of version v (v=0 => initial state) WITHOUT replaying from scratch when a snapshot at or before v exists: replay only events after the nearest snapshot. stateAt must throw RangeError for v<0 or v>version(). events() returns a copy of the full event list. query.js exports select(store, {type, from, to}) which returns the events (in order) whose event.type matches type (omit type => all types) and whose 1-based sequence number n satisfies from<=n<=to (from defaults to 1, to defaults to version()). Both bounds are INCLUSIVE. select must throw RangeError if from>to or to>store.version().
verifyCmd: node -e "const {createStore}=require('./store.js');const {select}=require('./query.js');const red=(s,e)=>{if(s===undefined)return{list:[]};if(e.type==='push')return{list:s.list.concat(e.v)};if(e.type==='pop')return{list:s.list.slice(0,-1)};return s};const st=createStore(red,3);const evs=[{type:'push',v:1},{type:'push',v:2},{type:'pop'},{type:'push',v:3},{type:'push',v:4},{type:'pop'},{type:'push',v:5}];for(const e of evs)st.append(e);if(st.version()!==7){console.error('version');process.exit(1)}const s4=st.stateAt(4);if(JSON.stringify(s4.list)!=='[1,3]'){console.error('stateAt4',JSON.stringify(s4));process.exit(1)}const s0=st.stateAt(0);if(JSON.stringify(s0.list)!=='[]'){console.error('stateAt0');process.exit(1)}const s7=st.stateAt(7);if(JSON.stringify(s7.list)!=='[1,3,5]'){console.error('stateAt7');process.exit(1)}s4.list.push(999);if(JSON.stringify(st.stateAt(4).list)!=='[1,3]'){console.error('snapshot isolation');process.exit(1)}try{st.stateAt(8);console.error('range high');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError)){console.error('RangeError type');process.exit(1)}}try{st.stateAt(-1);console.error('range low');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError)){process.exit(1)}}const pushes=select(st,{type:'push'});if(pushes.length!==5||pushes[4].v!==5){console.error('select type');process.exit(1)}const win=select(st,{from:3,to:5});if(win.length!==3||win[0].type!=='pop'||win[2].v!==4){console.error('select window');process.exit(1)}const defTo=select(st,{type:'pop',from:4});if(defTo.length!==1){console.error('default to');process.exit(1)}try{select(st,{from:5,to:4});console.error('from>to');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))process.exit(1)}try{select(st,{to:99});console.error('to>version');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))process.exit(1)}const ev=st.events();ev.pop();if(st.events().length!==7){console.error('events copy');process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
